data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":{"adopted_commitment_refs":[],"disanalogies":["Fuel is physical; fetch budget is logical","Fuel consumption is continuous; fetch budget is discrete"],"overturn_conditions":["If the agent can operate safely in a degraded mode without breaking replayability","If the cost of logging exceeds the cost of fetches"],"shared_structure":["Both involve a finite resource that must be monitored","Both require a clear terminal state upon exhaustion","Both need to prevent silent degradation"],"source_memory_refs":["SRC_001","SRC_002"],"transfer_claims":["A typed terminal state is analogous to a fuel warning light","Budget counters are analogous to fuel level sensors"]},"claim":"The fetch budget should be denominated in both requests and bytes, with exhaustion recorded as a typed auditable terminal state via a non-bypassable guard in the fetch loop.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the agent can make requests with unpredictable byte costs, a pure request-count budget may be insufficient to prevent resource exhaustion.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the agent compresses or transforms fetched data, byte counting may diverge across replays unless raw bytes are logged.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the agent has write access to its own code or budget counters, the guard may be bypassed.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the environment provides asynchronous fetch APIs, synchronous budget enforcement may be impossible.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Implement a dual-counter budget (request count and total bytes received) that is decremented synchronously after each fetch. The fetch loop is wrapped in a guard that checks both counters before each fetch; if either counter is zero, the agent transitions to a terminal state with a unique type identifier and logs the budget parameters and causal trigger. The log is append-only and records exact bytes received per fetch to ensure deterministic replay.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
